company.shortDescription: Lidoma is a gaming platform that brings communities together, organizes tournaments, and broadcasts online/offline gaming events.
company.description:
Lidoma is a gaming platform that brings communities together, organizes tournaments and leagues, and broadcasts online/offline events in some of the most popular mobile and PC game titles.

Lidoma is headquartered in Dubai, United Arab Emirates and was founded in 2020.

insights.title: Valuation increased across disclosed rounds
insights.statement: Known post-money valuation rose from $9,397,149 to $89,434,668, a 9.52x increase.
insights.implication: The disclosed financing history indicates a material valuation step-up between the earliest and latest rounds with known valuations.
caveats: Only rounds with a disclosed post-money valuation are compared.

insights.title: Sharp recent attention and growth momentum
insights.statement: Crunchbase scores growth at 34 (-1 over 90 days) and market heat at 58 (-11).
insights.implication: The company has recently become much more visible, but the scores should be treated as attention/activity indicators rather than revenue or clinical-performance metrics.
caveats: Crunchbase does not expose the complete weighting behind these proprietary scores.
